description: 1. The agent must locate and read the SKILL.md to discover that the fitness tracking system stores persistent memory at ~/fitness/memory.md in a strict 6-section markdown format (### Sources, ### Schedule, ### Correlations, ### Preferences, ### Flags, ### Achievements) with specific comment-style format hints. 2. The agent must read all four raw data files in /workspace (garmin export, chat logs, race results, strava summary) and absorb information from each. 3. From the data, the agent must correctly identify Marcus as an EXPERIENCED ATHLETE (not beginner), which means Preferences must reflect low proactivity: weekly summary only, no daily reminders, data-driven autonomy — per the 'proactivity scales inversely with experience' rule. 4. The Correlations section must capture: alcohol→next-day performance degradation (negative), coffee pre-workout→increased intensity (positive), and sleep as a performance factor. 5. The Flags section must contain SKILL.md-specified linguistic signals detected from the data: 'too tired', injury/knee mentions, HRV crashes. 6. The Achievements section must record: Kona Ironman World Championship finish with date (2024-10), sub-10 goal achieved, new FTP PR of 318w (2024-11), and new swim CSS PR. 7. The agent must NOT use any guilt language about missed workouts. 8. The file must be written to ~/fitness/memory.md (not just the workspace).
